summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing two debt restructuring agreements. On May 6, 2026, it entered a letter agreement with ACM Zoomcar Convert LLC to settle a ~$6M judgment: $2.5M cash due by Oct 31, 2026, and the ~$3.5M balance satisfied via equity at terms of the next financing; ACM also gets 10% of any capital-raising proceeds and granted a courtesy standstill through Mar 31, 2027. On May 14, it signed a standstill with CFI Capital LLC, agreeing not to convert a $150K convertible note before Sep 30, 2026. The board's recommendation is not stated. Watch for the company's ability to raise financing to meet cash payment obligations, as failure could trigger confession of judgment enforcement.
